The video has no subtitles, so I’m downloading the short clip and sampling its frames to count distinct bird species visible together.
I’m downloading the video for frame-by-frame inspection, since captions are unavailable and the question depends on what is simultaneously visible.
```python
download_output = await run_command("yt-dlp -f '18' --no-playlist --output './bird_video.%(ext)s' 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'")
print(download_output)
```
